blocks.text: Rented, not bought. Already have one? I need ten minutes of DNS access. Don't? We pick one together on our first call. Turn on auto-renew: an expired domain is the one thing I can't fix remotely.
Each site runs isolated on a server I maintain — patches, certificates, monitoring, all handled overnight without downtime.
Edit it yourself in the browser — free, live instantly. Or text me: small changes are free, usually same day. New pages or features get quoted up front before I start.
No plugins means almost nothing can break. If something does, monitoring alerts my phone before you notice — and you have my number directly. No ticket queue.
